messages:
Priya Nair: Quick alignment thread — roadmap item: 'parallel tool orchestration' API + launch checklist. Need to decide defaults, opt-in modes, and what we guarantee on ordering/retries. @Ethan please paste customer asks.

Ethan Moore: From search-and-ads pilot: two asks — 1) ability to fan-out scoring calls in parallel for latency, but enforce deterministic merge ordering for final ranking; 2) visibility into which calls timed out vs failed; 3) ability to mark certain calls as 'no-retry' (billing/charge). They prefer streaming partials.

Sasha Ivanov: Infra constraints: concurrent spikes => connection exhaustion + model KV churn. Recommend hard caps: max_parallel = 4 per orchestration, default per_call_timeout_ms = 4000, orchestration_timeout_ms = 25000. Retry defaults: idempotent calls 1 retry, non-idempotent 0. Circuit breaker per-tool.

Priya Nair: API proposal (sketch):
```json
{
  "model":"redwood-1",
  "workflow": [
    {"name":"lookup","tool":"profile.get","mode":"parallel","idempotency_key":"k1"},
    {"name":"score","tool":"ranker.score","mode":"parallel"},
    {"name":"apply_charge","tool":"payments.charge","mode":"sequential","after":["lookup","score"], "no_retry":true}
  ],
  "defaults": {"per_call_timeout_ms":4000, "max_parallel":4},
  "workflow_timeout_ms":25000
}
```

Priya Nair: Server returns `workflow_id` immediately and streams events: `{workflow_id,event_type,step_name,status,attempt,detail}`. Final top-level status = "complete" | "partial" | "failed".

Ethan Moore: Must have clear error codes for partial success (e.g., `PARTIAL_TIMEOUT`, `STEP_FAILED`, `NO_RETRY_SKIPPED`). Also we need sample SDK code that shows how to resume/compensate.

Sasha Ivanov: Ops: we will enforce per-customer concurrent workflows, global circuit breakers, and quota billing per attempted call (including retries). Need tracing hooks: workflow_id + step_span; emit metrics: workflow_completion_hist, step_latency_p50/p95, step_retry_count.

Priya Nair: Launch gating: docs + SDK examples (JS/Py), one customer pilot (ads/search), staging canary, Console shows per-step telemetry, and roll-out kill-switch. Also require opt-in header `X-Enable-Parallel-Workflow: true` for GA.

devex-bot: devex-bot: creating a tracking card with checklist: SDK examples, docs, canary, telemetry wiring.

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled staging canary for parallel-workflows on 2026-04-07T15:00Z

Priya Nair: Decision: proceed with MVP as above, opt-in only, defaults per Sasha. I'll open a spec PR with acceptance criteria and link the tracking card. Comments within 48h please. :calendar:
